turns.text: I think implementing Redux Saga might help us manage these complex asynchronous flows better.
turns.zh: 我觉得用 Redux Saga 可能能帮我们更好地管理这些复杂的异步流程。

turns.text: Have you discussed this with the rest of the front-end team?
turns.zh: 你跟前端团队其他人讨论过这个吗？

turns.text: I'm trying to put together a small proof of concept before bringing it up.
turns.zh: 我想先做一个小原型出来，然后再提。

turns.text: But, I may need their input soon.
turns.zh: 不过，我可能很快需要他们的意见。

turns.text: What about the new UI components?
turns.zh: 那新的 UI 组件呢？

turns.text: When do you think they'll be ready for review?
turns.zh: 你觉得它们什么时候能准备好评审？
